taskChanges.newValue: Reproduced failure by round-tripping state with alphabetically ordered object keys: successful RPC ignored. Fixed sameCall to compare nested JSON values independently of object key order, preserving array ordering and all argument values. Regression proves create confirmation becomes active, 5-minute wait survives 2-minute RPC deadline, and another boss confirmation is ignored. 42 raid/background tests pass; all suites except known missing private quest-data fixture pass; build 0.9.96 passes; git diff --check passes.
